base: High-definition 2D game art for a modern, polished life-simulation game (cozy, detailed, professional mobile game quality). Clean digital illustration with crisp edges, soft painterly shading, gentle ambient occlusion, warm natural daylight coming from the top-left. Consistent isometric camera: 2:1 dimetric projection (about 30 degrees elevation, rotated 45 degrees), as in classic isometric life-sim games.
character: Single full-body character, natural human proportions (about 7.5 heads tall), expressive friendly face, realistic hair and clothing folds, feet fully visible, centered with generous empty margin around it. Transparent background, no ground, no shadow on the floor.
sheet: Sprite sheet on a transparent background: the SAME character repeated identically (same face, hair, clothes, colors, size) in each cell, cells evenly spaced in a single horizontal row, all characters standing on the same baseline and the same scale, nothing overlapping, no text, no grid lines, no labels.
building: Single isolated building game asset viewed from the isometric camera, the whole building visible including roof and base, both visible facades (front-left and front-right) detailed. Transparent background, no ground tiles, no street, no people, no text other than shop signs explicitly requested.
object: Single isolated game object viewed from the isometric camera, entire object visible, transparent background, no floor, no text.
tile: Seamless isometric ground tile shaped exactly as a 2:1 diamond filling the image width, viewed from the isometric camera, transparent outside the diamond.
huambo: Setting: the real city of Huambo, Angola, exactly as shown in the attached reference photographs of present-day Huambo. Reproduce the real architecture, materials, colors, wear, signage style, vegetation, street furniture, vehicles and the way people dress as seen in those photos. Do not invent a generic city.
negative: Avoid: pixel art, low resolution, blur, photo-realism, 3D render look, watermarks, extra limbs, cropped parts, background scenery.
texture: Flat top-down texture filling the entire square image edge to edge, seamless and tileable, no perspective, no vignette, no border.
room: Isometric cutaway room for a life-simulation game: floor diamond and two back walls only, viewed from the isometric camera, transparent background outside the room, no furniture unless requested, no people, no text.
huambo_text: Setting: present-day Huambo, Angola (central highlands, ~1700 m altitude). Use the real local context: Portuguese colonial-era buildings in pastel colors (pink, ochre, pale yellow, light blue) with terracotta tile roofs and arched porticos; 1960s-70s modernist concrete apartment blocks with balconies, water tanks and satellite dishes on the roofs; newer cement-block houses with corrugated zinc roofs, painted walls and simple metal gates; small shops (cantinas) with hand-painted signs and Coca-Cola/Cuca adverts; red-earth (laterite) ground, jacaranda, eucalyptus and palm trees, bougainvillea; blue-and-white candongueiro minibuses, kupapata motorbike taxis, zungueiras with basins on their heads; all signage written in Portuguese. Never a generic or Western city.
bairro_kit: Huge game ASSET SHEET for ONE whole Huambo neighbourhood: many separate, fully isolated isometric game assets laid out in a loose grid on a fully transparent background, each asset completely visible and separated from the others by clear empty space (no overlapping, no ground between them, no streets, no shadows connecting them). All assets share the same isometric camera, light direction and scale (a 2-storey house is about 1.5 times the height of a person-sized street lamp ratio as in reality). Bigger buildings first in the upper rows, smaller props below.
